abstract_sentences.text: Scaling generative AI models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality training data.

evidence.anchor: scarcity of high-quality training data

abstract_sentences.text: The ease of synthesizing from a generative model suggests using (unverified) synthetic data to augment a limited corpus of real data for the purpose of fine-tuning in the hope of improving performance.

evidence.anchor: using (unverified) synthetic data to augment a limited corpus

abstract_sentences.text: Unfortunately, however, the resulting positive feedback loop leads to model autophagy disorder (MAD, aka model collapse) that results in a rapid degradation in sample quality and/or diversity.

evidence.anchor: rapid degradation in sample quality and/or diversity

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we introduce Neon (for Negative Extrapolation frOm self-traiNing), a new learning method that turns the degradation from self-training into a powerful signal for self-improvement.

evidence.anchor: turns the degradation from self-training into a powerful signal

abstract_sentences.text: Given a base model, Neon first fine-tunes it on its own self-synthesized data but then, counterintuitively, reverses its gradient updates to extrapolate away from the degraded weights.

evidence.anchor: reverses its gradient updates to extrapolate away

abstract_sentences.text: We prove that Neon works because typical inference samplers that favor high-probability regions create a predictable anti-alignment between the synthetic and real data population gradients, which negative extrapolation corrects to better align the model with the true data distribution.

evidence.anchor: predictable anti-alignment between the synthetic and real data population gradients

abstract_sentences.text: Neon is remarkably easy to implement via a simple post-hoc merge that requires no new real data, works effectively with as few as 1k synthetic samples, and typically uses less than 1% additional training compute.

evidence.anchor: as few as 1k synthetic samples; less than 1% additional training compute

abstract_sentences.text: We demonstrate Neon’s universality across a range of architectures (diffusion, flow matching, autoregressive, and inductive moment matching models) and datasets (ImageNet, CIFAR-10, and FFHQ).

evidence.anchor: across a range of architectures and datasets

abstract_sentences.text: In particular, on ImageNet 256x256, Neon elevates the xAR-L model to a new state-of-the-art FID of 1.02 with only 0.36% additional training compute.

evidence.anchor: FID of 1.02 with only 0.36% additional training compute

claim_closure.claim: C1: simple post-hoc merge with no new real data, auxiliary model, likelihood, or inference modification
claim_closure.method_response: Equations (1)/(2) and Algorithm 1 perform one short self-fine-tune followed by a parameter merge.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Appendix C documents direct parameter merge, buffers, normalization, and fp16 handling; all four model families are run.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion restates Neon as simple and efficient post-processing.

evidence.anchor: θNeon := θr − w(θs − θr)
merge applies directly to model parameters

claim_closure.claim: C2: mode-seeking samplers create anti-alignment that guarantees Neon effectiveness
claim_closure.method_response: s, b, Δ, cosφ and the Taylor expansion supply the causal chain.
claim_closure.evidence_response: B.1–B.7 and toy B.11 support the sign story, but A-MONO and local assumptions are not directly estimated in the main experiments.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion recalls anti-alignment as the grounding insight.

evidence.anchor: Theorem 1 (Anti-alignment under inference mismatch)
Assumption (A-MONO: curvature–density coupling)
cosine similarity is still negative at ζ = 1

claim_closure.claim: C3: universal coverage across four families, three datasets, <1% compute, and 1k samples
claim_closure.method_response: Algorithm 1 and family-specific Appendix C recipes instantiate the same merge.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Results cover EDM, Flow, xAR/VAR, and IMM; Flow uses 3.2% and 1k is explicitly shown for xAR, so the headline requires configuration-specific qualification.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion uses diverse architectures and datasets without enumerating the boundary.

evidence.anchor: four model families
3.2% additional compute
Even with just 1k samples

claim_closure.claim: C4: improvement operates through a precision–recall redistribution
claim_closure.method_response: Mode-seeking bias and reverse direction predict a precision cost and recall gain.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig.4 and Fig.D.1 show the directional P/R pattern; no independent intervention separates it from metric/CFG selection.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion explicitly links extrapolation to recall and fidelity.

evidence.anchor: precision monotonically decreases with w, while recall follows an inverted-U
precision-recall trade-off across diffusion and flow matching architectures

claim_closure.claim: C5: degradation signal transfers across model architectures
claim_closure.method_response: Appendix B.8 gives neighborhood and cross-architecture norm/bias conditions.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig.8 shows Flow→EDM and IMM→EDM FID improvements, but does not measure Hessian or sampler-bias closeness.

claim_closure.method_response: AR monotone reweighting and finite-step ODE/A-MONO arguments derive s<0.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 短 synthetic fine-tuning 测量由 mode-seeking inference 诱发的 degradation direction，再沿相反方向 merge；s<0 是理论桥，precision–recall 变化是机制桥，跨模型结果是应用回收。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留公式(1)/(2)、Algorithm 1、Theorem 1/2 的概要、主 benchmark 曲线、FID 数字、Fig.4 机制和 Fig.6 交互，以及关键边界消融。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整 proofs、A1–A4/A-MONO、finite-|S| bounds、各 family recipe、Table A.1、补充 P/R 曲线、class grids 和单样本差分移入 Appendix A–K。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.2 toy 几何 → merge 公式/短算法 → s<0 Taylor 展开 → Fig.4 P/R 机制 → Fig.6 w/γ 交互，形成从直觉到机制再到结果的短闭环。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “universality/guarantee/<1%”的强包装先于局部条件；A-MONO、cross-architecture 几何和 grid-selected FID 未由独立估计、重复 seed 或 held-out 评测充分闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 反转退化信号的论文应把信号方向、可操作变换、中间机制指标、主结果和明确反例放在一条可追踪链上，并对最优调参结果给固定配置或稳定性证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合能以短步估计方向、保留 base checkpoint、且有明确方向性指标的后处理；diversity-seeking、远离 optimum、连续时间无离散 bias、几何不共享或只有单一 aggregate metric 时必须重新测 s 和机制变量。

reading_protocol_notes.layout: Title/abstract page is single-column; main and theory pages are primarily two-column with several wide floats and full-page visual appendix plates.
reading_protocol_notes.formula_count_summary: Six numbered equations in the main text (1–6), nine numbered appendix equations (B.1–B.9), fifteen numbered total; roughly 35 displayed-math blocks assigned to appendix module metrics, excluding repeated line fragments.
reading_protocol_notes.visual_count_summary: 33 figure captions, 2 tables, 1 algorithm in full PDF; 10 main figures (Fig.1–10) and 23 appendix figures.

lexical_analysis.scope: Main text pages 1-10 after excluding headers, References, formula fragments, table values, and fixed template words; counts are approximate semantic tokens.
lexical_analysis.rhetorical_notes: Domain nouns drive model/data/FID frequency; Neon/degradation/direction/anti-alignment drive the causal chain; strong claims and local/typical/likely qualifiers coexist.

statistical_notes.aggregation_unit: Generated sample set; FID on 10k search or 50k final samples; P/R via InceptionV3 features and prdc k=5.
statistical_notes.center_and_spread: Point estimates, minima over w or (w,γ), and curves; no uncertainty expression, repeated-seed spread, bootstrap, or conventional significance test.
statistical_notes.selection: Hyperparameters are selected by preliminary FID and then final FID is computed at the selected setting.
statistical_notes.mechanism: Precision/Recall curves, asymptotic P/R curves, and toy gradient cosine are the main mechanism diagnostics.
statistical_notes.interpretive_boundary: Reported results support point improvements under the stated checkpoints, sampling settings, search ranges, and evaluation scripts; they do not establish distribution-wide statistical stability.
